approval.rationale: The longest measured prompt is 155 tokens, so 192 preserves all 150 prompts with reasonable headroom. The longest full prompt+response sequence is 217 tokens (prompt+rejected), so 256 preserves every chosen and rejected sequence (0 truncated at 256 for either). Using 192 for max_length would truncate 46.0% of chosen and 58.67% of rejected sequences; 384/512 provide no additional data-preservation benefit over 256 and would increase memory use. Human-approved from the real Colab tokenizer run before being written into configs/dpo_config.json.
